Check the username and recipient, enable delivery, and open a fresh clinical report before sending a summary.

Use a dedicated bot from @BotFather. Enable delivery only for people you trust with your health data. Bot chats are not end-to-end encrypted. Recipients cannot change therapy or silence local alarms. OFF also pauses Telegram alerts. Telegram needs an internet connection and does not replace local alerts. Report consent is separate for each recipient. Disconnect before changing the bot token; this clears the trusted recipient list.
